HTTP++ import.Imports:
Imports System.Net
Imports System.Text
Imports System.Threading
Imports System.Threading.Tasks
HTTP++ import.CustomSubs:
Public Sub httppp_HttpGet(url As String, callback As Action(Of String, Integer))
		ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(Sub()
			Try
				Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
				request.Method = "GET"

				Dim response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)

				Dim reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
				Dim content As String = reader.ReadToEnd()

				callback.Invoke(content, CInt(response.StatusCode))
			Catch ex As Exception
				callback.Invoke(ex.Message, -1)
			End Try
		End Sub)
	End Sub

	Public Sub httppp_HttpPost(url As String, body As String, callback As Action(Of String, Integer))
		ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(Sub()
			Try
				Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
				request.Method = "POST"
				request.ContentType = "application/json"

				Dim data As Byte() =System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(body)
				request.ContentLength = data.Length

				Using stream = request.GetRequestStream()
					stream.Write(data, 0, data.Length)
				End Using

				Dim response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)

				Dim reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
				Dim content As String = reader.ReadToEnd()

				callback.Invoke(content, CInt(response.StatusCode))
			Catch ex As Exception
				callback.Invoke(ex.Message, -1)
			End Try
		End Sub)
	End Sub
